heading: Combination with other extensions
text:
### Combination with other extensions [LNLS.2.2]

`linear_scan: false` combines with any other setting. Interactions:

| With `linear_scan: false` and | Effect |
|---|---|
| `realtime: true` | See [LNLS.2.4] for the precise overlap. Together they produce the tightest possible T_wcet guarantee — both allocation and algorithmic bounds. |
| Any other setting | No interaction unless it permits a construct excluded by [LNLS.3]. |

The `realtime: true` row is deferred with that capability, and the compiler
refuses it in this edition ([LCAP.2.1.5]).
